d: Deep midnight blue hair flows long and straight, styled with sharp bangs and a single long strand falling between the eyes. Golden-amber eyes are narrow and focused, set on a youthful face with a small red star-shaped mark centered on the forehead. The build is slender and fit, wearing a white and red asymmetric outfit featuring a short red tunic, a white draped overskirt, white thigh-high boots with black star accents, and white gloves. Two small red horns protrude from the head, accompanied by pointed elf-like ears and a golden ornament on the left ear.
